call_census.note: byte-pattern census over the complete .text for e8/ff15/lea encodings

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

giant.scope: FDE record and the datediff call site only; the body itself stays unbound

shared_anchors.note: datediff core and 1e6 double shared with RE-001-datediff-chrono-94

structure.observed: datediff returns (i64 seconds, i32 nanos); a borrow flag (seconds < 0 and nanos > 0) adjusts both parts; the seconds scale by 1e6, the nanos divide by 1000 through the 0x10624dd3 magic with shift 38, the sums convert to double and divide by the shared 1e6 double; the result is masked with the absolute-value constant pair
structure.overflow_guards: two seto/jne pairs skip the conversion on overflow
